scripts.lint: biome check . && turbo run lint && node infra/check.ts
scripts.gen:check: pnpm gen && git diff --exit-code -- packages/schemas/src/generated packages/schemas/python apps/api/src/generated
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm config:check && pnpm gen:check
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm --filter @anr/db run migrate && pnpm --filter @anr/db run migrate:test
scripts.db:roles: docker compose --env-file .env -f infra/compose.yaml exec postgres anr-roles
scripts.css:tools: tailwindcss -i packages/schemas/viewer/tags.src.css -o packages/schemas/viewer/tags.build.css --minify && tailwindcss -i tools/tts-eval/tags.src.css -o tools/tts-eval/tags.build.css --minify
